# Solution: Add ACK-Managed S3 Logs Bucket + IRSA Role + Flux Kustomization

I'll provide the complete file structure and manifests following knr-ops patterns. Note: The CRD group `s3.aws.upbound.io` indicates you're using Upbound's Crossplane provider (not pure ACK), so I'll provide resources for that; adapt the apiVersion if using ACK's `s3.services.k8s.aws`.

## Directory Structure

```
infra/logs-bucket/
├── base/
│   ├── kustomization.yaml
│   ├── bucket.yaml
│   └── irsa-role.yaml
overlays/
├── dev/
│   ├── logs-bucket/
│   │   └── kustomization.yaml
│   └── kustomization.yaml (updated to include logs-bucket)
└── prod/
    ├── logs-bucket/
    │   └── kustomization.yaml
    └── kustomization.yaml (updated to include logs-bucket)
flux/
└── logs-bucket-kustomization.yaml (new Flux kustomization resource)
```

---

## 1. Base Manifests

### `infra/logs-bucket/base/kustomization.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization

namespace: crossplane-system

commonLabels:
  app.kubernetes.io/name: logs-bucket
  app.kubernetes.io/component: storage

resources:
  - bucket.yaml
  - irsa-role.yaml
```

### `infra/logs-bucket/base/bucket.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    # bucket name will be set via overlay patches (dev: myapp-logs-dev, prod: myapp-logs-prod)
    bucket: myapp-logs-dev  # placeholder; patched by overlay
    region: us-east-1
    
    # Versioning
    versioningConfiguration:
      - status: Enabled
    
    # Server-side encryption (AES256)
    serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
      - ruleConfiguration:
          - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              - sseAlgorithm: AES256
    
    # Public access block (deny all public access)
    publicAccessBlockConfiguration:
      - blockPublicAcls: true
        blockPublicPolicy: true
        ignorePublicAcls: true
        restrictPublicBuckets: true
  
  providerConfigRef:
    name: default  # or your AWS provider config name
```

### `infra/logs-bucket/base/irsa-role.yaml`

```yaml
---
# IAM Role for IRSA (trusts the EKS OIDC provider)
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: logs-bucket-irsa
spec:
  forProvider:
    name: logs-bucket-irsa-dev  # patched by overlay for prod
    assumeRolePolicyDocument: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Principal": {
              "Federated": "arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.REGION.amazonaws.com/id/EXAMPLED539D4633E53DE1B716D3041E"
            },
            "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
            "Condition": {
              "StringEquals": {
                "oidc.eks.REGION.amazonaws.com/id/EXAMPLED539D4633E53DE1B716D3041E:sub": "system:serviceaccount:APP_NAMESPACE:logs-bucket-sa",
                "oidc.eks.REGION.amazonaws.com/id/EXAMPLED539D4633E53DE1B716D3041E:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com"
              }
            }
          }
        ]
      }
  providerConfigRef:
    name: default

---
# Inline policy: read/write to logs bucket
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: RolePolicy
metadata:
  name: logs-bucket-policy
spec:
  forProvider:
    name: logs-bucket-policy
    roleRef:
      name: logs-bucket-irsa
    policy: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": [
              "s3:GetObject",
              "s3:PutObject",
              "s3:DeleteObject",
              "s3:ListBucket"
            ],
            "Resource": [
              "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-*",
              "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-*/*"
            ]
          }
        ]
      }
  providerConfigRef:
    name: default

---
# Kubernetes ServiceAccount to be annotated with IRSA role
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: logs-bucket-sa
  namespace: default  # adjust to your app namespace
  annotations:
    eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:role/logs-bucket-irsa-dev
```

**Note on IRSA Setup:** The assume role policy contains placeholder values (ACCOUNT_ID, REGION, OIDC provider ID, APP_NAMESPACE). These must be interpolated at deployment time using kustomize overlays or external tooling (e.g., `kustomize` strategic merge patches).

---

## 2. Environment Overlays

### `overlays/dev/logs-bucket/kustomization.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization

namespace: default  # or your app namespace

bases:
  - ../../../infra/logs-bucket/base

# Patch bucket name
patchesJson6902:
  - target:
      group: s3.aws.upbound.io
      version: v1beta1
      kind: Bucket
      name: myapp-logs
    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forProvider/bucket
        value: myapp-logs-dev
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forProvider/region
        value: us-east-1

  # Patch IAM role names and OIDC details for dev
  - target:
      group: iam.aws.upbound.io
      version: v1beta1
      kind: Role
      name: logs-bucket-irsa
    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forProvider/name
        value: logs-bucket-irsa-dev
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forProvider/assumeRolePolicyDocument
        value: |
          {
            "Version": "2012-10-17",
            "Statement": [
              {
                "Effect": "Allow",
                "Principal": {
                  "Federated": "arn:aws:iam::DEV_ACCOUNT_ID:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEV_OIDC_ID"
                },
                "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
                "Condition": {
                  "StringEquals": {
                    "oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEV_OIDC_ID:sub": "system:serviceaccount:default:logs-bucket-sa",
                    "oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEV_OIDC_ID:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com"
                  }
                }
              }
            ]
          }

  - target:
      group: iam.aws.upbound.io
      version: v1beta1
      kind: ServiceAccount
      name: logs-bucket-sa
    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /metadata/annotations/eks.amazonaws.com~1role-arn
        value: arn:aws:iam::DEV_ACCOUNT_ID:role/logs-bucket-irsa-dev
```

### `overlays/prod/logs-bucket/kustomization.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization

namespace: default  # or your app namespace

bases:
  - ../../../infra/logs-bucket/base

patchesJson6902:
  - target:
      group: s3.aws.upbound.io
      version: v1beta1
      kind: Bucket
      name: myapp-logs
    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forProvider/bucket
        value: myapp-logs-prod
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forProvider/region
        value: us-east-1

  - target:
      group: iam.aws.upbound.io
      version: v1beta1
      kind: Role
      name: logs-bucket-irsa
    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forProvider/name
        value: logs-bucket-irsa-prod
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forProvider/assumeRolePolicyDocument
        value: |
          {
            "Version": "2012-10-17",
            "Statement": [
              {
                "Effect": "Allow",
                "Principal": {
                  "Federated": "arn:aws:iam::PROD_ACCOUNT_ID:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/PROD_OIDC_ID"
                },
                "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
                "Condition": {
                  "StringEquals": {
                    "oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/PROD_OIDC_ID:sub": "system:serviceaccount:default:logs-bucket-sa",
                    "oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/PROD_OIDC_ID:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com"
                  }
                }
              }
            ]
          }

  - target:
      group: iam.aws.upbound.io
      version: v1beta1
      kind: ServiceAccount
      name: logs-bucket-sa
    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /metadata/annotations/eks.amazonaws.com~1role-arn
        value: arn:aws:iam::PROD_ACCOUNT_ID:role/logs-bucket-irsa-prod
```

---

## 3. Flux Kustomization

### `flux/logs-bucket-kustomization.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: logs-bucket
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  # Reconcile every 10 minutes
  interval: 10m
  
  # Path to kustomize overlay (dev or prod selected by Flux instance context)
  # For a multi-env Flux setup, use:
  #   path: ./overlays/${CLUSTER_ENV}/logs-bucket
  # Or use separate Kustomization resources per environment (below)
  
  # Source: GitRepository pointing to your knr-ops repo
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: knr-ops
    namespace: flux-system
  
  path: ./overlays/dev/logs-bucket
  
  # Prune ensures orphaned resources are removed
  prune: true
  
  # Health checks for Bucket and Role CRDs
  healthChecks:
    - apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
      kind: Bucket
      name: myapp-logs
    - apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
      kind: Role
      name: logs-bucket-irsa
  
  # If using SOPS (see below for encrypted values)
  decryption:
    provider: sops
    secretRef:
      name: sops-age
```

**For multi-environment setups, create separate Kustomization resources:**

```yaml
---
# Prod variant
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: logs-bucket-prod
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: knr-ops
    namespace: flux-system
  path: ./overlays/prod/logs-bucket
  prune: true
  healthChecks:
    - apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
      kind: Bucket
      name: myapp-logs
    - apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
      kind: Role
      name: logs-bucket-irsa
```

---

## 4. SOPS-Encrypted Secrets (Optional)

If you need to encrypt sensitive values (e.g., OIDC provider IDs), create a secret:

### `infra/logs-bucket/base/secrets.yaml` (encrypted with SOPS)

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: logs-bucket-config
  namespace: crossplane-system
type: Opaque
stringData:
  oidc-provider-dev: "arn:aws:iam::DEV_ACCOUNT_ID:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEV_OIDC_ID"
  oidc-provider-prod: "arn:aws:iam::PROD_ACCOUNT_ID:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/PROD_OIDC_ID"
```

Encrypt with:
```bash
sops --encrypt infra/logs-bucket/base/secrets.yaml > infra/logs-bucket/base/secrets.sops.yaml
```

Then reference in overlays via kustomize `secretGenerator` or as a ConfigMap.

---

## 5. Integration with Top-Level Overlays

Update your existing `overlays/dev/kustomization.yaml` and `overlays/prod/kustomization.yaml`:

### `overlays/dev/kustomization.yaml` (add this resource)

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization

# ... existing resources ...

resources:
  - logs-bucket/  # include the logs-bucket overlay
  # - other resources
```

---

## Key Implementation Details

1. **Bucket Naming**: Dev and prod bucket names are differentiated via `patchesJson6902` in overlays, avoiding hard-coded environment names in base manifests.

2. **IRSA Setup**: The ServiceAccount annotation `eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn` enables IRSA. Pods using this service account automatically receive AWS credentials via the EKS OIDC provider.

3. **Public Access Block**: Enforced at bucket creation; all four restrictions enabled (block public ACLs, policies, ignore existing ACLs, restrict public buckets).

4. **Versioning & Encryption**: Enabled in base manifest; inherited by both dev and prod.

5. **Flux Health Checks**: Kustomization monitors Bucket and Role objects for readiness before considering the sync successful.

6. **Environment Isolation**: Dev and prod clusters can have separate Kustomization resources pointing to their respective overlays, ensuring independent reconciliation.

---

## Pre-Deployment Checklist

- [ ] Replace `DEV_ACCOUNT_ID`, `PROD_ACCOUNT_ID`, `DEV_OIDC_ID`, `PROD_OIDC_ID` with actual values
- [ ] Set `APP_NAMESPACE` to the namespace where your application pods run
- [ ] Verify Upbound provider config name (default assumed as `default`)
- [ ] Ensure Flux GitRepository `knr-ops` exists and points to your repo
- [ ] Test kustomize output: `kustomize build overlays/dev/logs-bucket`
- [ ] Encrypt sensitive values with SOPS if desired
- [ ] Apply Flux Kustomization resource to `flux-system` namespace

This solution follows knr-ops idiom: declarative, environment-aware, GitOps-driven, and security-hardened.
